query: Create a preview environment for the current branch
expected_behavior: Detects current branch via `git branch --show-current` and PR metadata via `gh` if available
Searches for an existing blueprint environment by listing /project/{projectId}/environment
If no blueprint exists, walks Phase 2 (clone staging, configure auto_preview, deploy, validate, stop)
Clones the blueprint into `preview-{branch-or-pr}` via POST /environment/{envId}/clone
Switches each application's branch via PUT /application/{appId}
Configures auto-shutdown (Phase 4) — stop / delete / recycle as appropriate
Returns the public URLs once deployed

query: Set up automatic cleanup so previews older than 5 days get deleted
expected_behavior: Creates a scoped API token via POST /organization/{orgId}/apiToken with sensible permissions
Generates a cron job that walks `/project/.../environment` and deletes preview-* environments older than 5 days
Stores the API token as a job secret
Schedules the job to run daily during off-hours

query: Only preview the frontend service for this PR — leave the backend pointing at staging
expected_behavior: Recognizes a single-service preview scope per reference/phase3-preview-from-blueprint.md
Clones the blueprint with a filter so only the frontend is reset to the PR branch
Leaves backend and database services pointing at the blueprint defaults
Configures the frontend's BACKEND_API_URL env var (interpolation or alias) to point at the staging backend
Confirms the plan via the Phase 5 summary before deploying
